source.title: Three Open Problems in Functional Equations

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 856879.

Queried the zbMATH API for an:856879. The record identified DOI 10.2307/2974646 but the title and bibliographic text exposed through zbMATH were license-redacted, so zbMATH was treated only as a resolver.

Queried Crossref and OpenAlex for DOI 10.2307/2974646. Crossref identified the exact work as P. K. Sahoo, "Three Open Problems in Functional Equations", American Mathematical Monthly 102(8), 741-742, 1995, with canonical DOI 10.1080/00029890.1995.12004652 and Taylor & Francis full/PDF links. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, and no repository full text.

Attempted the DOI/Taylor & Francis landing and PDF routes. The DOI chain reached the Taylor & Francis article page, but direct access was blocked by a Cloudflare 403 challenge; direct PDF fetching did not produce a readable artifact. The JSTOR stable route for DOI 10.2307/2974646 also did not produce a readable artifact in the available environment.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery searches for the exact title, both DOI forms, and author/title combinations. The inspected candidates were metadata-only pages, the Taylor & Francis table of contents, or different works; none exposed the article's problem statements as readable PDF or full HTML.
